market.what: gold recovered from formally recycled e-waste (smelter + hydromet routes), world
market.method: GEM 2024: e-waste gold $15B at 2022 price (~260 t); 22% formally recycled = ~57 t x $4,150/oz x 32,151 oz/t = $7.6B (est.)
market.job_what: charges paid to recover gold from formally recycled e-waste boards (smelter/refiner treatment charges + unpaid gold), world
market.job_method: est.: ~0.66 Mt formal PCB/yr (3 Mt WPCB x 22% formal) x ~$1,000/t TC (US lots $1,300-3,000/t) x ~70% gold share = $0.46B + 2% unpaid Au on ~57 t x $133M/t = $0.15B; low confidence

value.logic: if ~30 t/yr of e-waste gold moves to local cyanide-free hydromet with a selective binder: ~+7% payable vs smelter/cyanide route (fewer losses, no CN treatment, faster cash) x $133M/t Au = $280M/yr
value.revenue_logic: binder/resin sold to processors priced ~1% of gold captured: 20% of 30 t x $133M/t x 1% = $8M
value.margin_logic: specialty sorbent/extractant consumable, reused many cycles; value-priced vs gold

trend.drivers: e-waste 62 Mt (2022) to 82 Mt (2030); gold near $4,150/oz; cyanide bans and permitting pain; local urban-mining plants (Royal Mint, Mint Innovation)

competition.paper_query: cyanide-free gold recovery printed circuit boards
competition.notes: Smelters (Umicore, Boliden, Aurubis) take most PCB gold. Excir: Royal Mint ~8% stake Apr 2025, UK plant live; Mint Innovation ~$60M raise, Sydney plant 3 kt PCB/yr; Cycladex (Stoddart, alpha-cyclodextrin) closest binder analog

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: small thioamide/amide or cyclodextrin-adduct binders; 3 variants
lab.test: leach milled PCB in a non-cyanide lixiviant (halide or thiosulfate), then Au uptake and selectivity vs Cu/Ni/Ag/Sn by ICP-MS; PCB head grade by fire assay (SGS/ALS); stripping test
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + tests 3 wk; 3 x $6k CRO + ~80 ICP-MS x $50 + fire assays ~$1k + lab time ~$2k

sale.gates: no product cert; pilot on a refiner's real PCB leach 6-12 mo; purity spec of recovered gold; supply contract
